resolvedFindings.title: A previous identity can replace or unsubscribe a newly bound account subscription
reproduction: Pause account A enable while serviceWorker.register is unresolved.
Switch the mounted UI to account B in another store and complete B enable.
Resume A register; the original helper unsubscribes B and creates an A-key subscription before the outer current-identity guard runs.
resolvedFindings.impact: B loses the working device subscription. The old action cannot save under B, but its browser mutation has already damaged the binding.
resolvedFindings.status: fixed and independently rechecked in current working tree
resolvedFindings.fix: Shared browser mutation queue; identity guards between awaited stages; real subscribe/unsubscribe promises retain the queue after a UI timeout.
verification: Controlled delayed-register and delayed-getRegistration interleavings only create B subscription.
Held real subscribe + simulated 10-second UI deadline keeps B queued until A actual mutation settles; then B removes the A-key result and establishes B.
